text:
Sam Cheng: Heads up — vendor just flagged a partial DOA batch and wants to rebook 6 units on air with a surcharge. AWB CVG1234567890.
Maria Ortiz: Ugh, which allocation is this against?
Sam Cheng: This is from the FRA reserve top-off, 6x H100s. Allocation id: alloc-2026-fra-07.
Jeff Patel: ETA on the rebook? air-express says earliest flight is 03/28, customs hold expected 24-48h.
Sam Cheng: Vendor quoted expedite surcharge €1,450 per unit for next-day air.
Anya Kowalski: That blows our cost model for Dedicated pool spikes. Can we split — 3 via air, 3 via sea (cheaper) and use loaners?
Maria Ortiz: We have 4 loaners in AMS that can cover immediate demand for up to 72h. Suggest: air 2 urgent, loaners 4, sea 0 for now.
RMA Ops: Serial reconciliation pending. We need depot photos + failure codes before AWB switch. Please upload to the RMA tracker: https://rma.internal/track/alloc-2026-fra-07
procurement-bot: Note: vendor contract cap on expedited surcharges is $12k/month. Current month usage: $9.2k.
Jeff Patel: If we do 2 air rebooks at €1,450 each that's €2,900 (~$3,150) — within the remaining surcharge budget but will reduce headroom.
Anya Kowalski: Ops question — do the loaners require firmware parity or will they need reimage? We can't accept long reprovision time.
Sam Cheng: Loaners are on the 1.6.2 image; target fleet is 1.6.4. Reimage time ~ 40m per node, with parallelization we can have all 4 up in 90m.
Maria Ortiz: Also flag: FRA customs has been stricter on refurbished units last week. If vendor marks as 'refurb' might trigger extra hold. Need vendor to declare import as 'replacement under warranty' to avoid extra docs.
RMA Ops: Agreed. Vendor must send commercial invoice with "replacement under warranty" and include depot photos + serials before dispatch. Otherwise customs might add 3-5 day hold.
procurement-bot: Reminder: approval required from finance for any single shipment > $10k surcharge. Total proposed expedite cost = ~$3.15k, no finance sign-off needed.
Jeff Patel: Can vendor split AWB so we send 2 air and 4 loaners? They suggested splitting but charge coordination fee. What's the coordination fee?
Sam Cheng: Vendor wants a one-time coordination fee €600. If we do 2 air + 4 loaners that's: 2*€1450 + €600 = €3500 (~$3,800).
Anya Kowalski: I'm fine with that if loaners can be reprovisioned quickly. We still need routing for private deployments in EU — latency-sensitive customers shouldn't see degraded perf.
Maria Ortiz: Ops plan: reimage 4 loaners to 1.6.4, route traffic with canary at 10% then 50% once verified. Should preserve SLOs.
RMA Ops: I'll hold RMA approval until we get vendor photos + serial list. Also request vendor to pre-clear customs text. I'll post template message they can copy.
Sam Cheng: I'll ping vendor now — copying @maria for contract angle.
Maria Ortiz: If vendor won't mark as warranty replacement, ask them to cover any customs/detention fees.
procurement-bot: Contract clause reference: "Expedited shipments and customs duty are vendor responsibility if mis-declared." See CL-EX-9.
Jeff Patel: TL;DR: Proposed path: air 2 units (urgent), loaners 4->reimage, vendor to provide RMA evidence + customs text, charge €600 coordination. Need final OK from Maria to proceed.
Maria Ortiz: OK proceed with the split. Sam, tell vendor: 2 air, provide RMA evidence within 4h, mark as warranty replacement, vendor covers customs if mis-declared. Proceed with AWB CVG1234567890 once we have confirmation.
Sam Cheng: On it. I'll update thread with vendor confirmation and attached photos once they arrive.
RMA Ops: Once photos uploaded I'll issue temporary release for loaners and schedule depot pickup window.
Anya Kowalski: I'll prepare canary routing plan and a rollback runbook. Pasting snippet for ops:
```
# quick rollback
1. Shift canary back to baseline traffic: /routes/canary -> v0.92
2. Drain loaner nodes: kubectl cordon && drain --ignore-daemonsets
3. Reattach replaced nodes once verified
```
Sam Cheng: Vendor replied: "Photos uploaded, serials attached, will mark as warranty replacement." Upload in 5.
Maria Ortiz: Great. Finance notified via procurement-bot.
Jeff Patel: Thanks team. Keep updates short in this thread. :thumbsup:
Sam Cheng: Uploaded photos + serial list to RMA tracker. Vendor confirmed AWB split and coordination fee waived if we accept 4 loaners.
Maria Ortiz: Perfect. Closing decision: 2 air, 4 loaners, vendor marks warranty replacement, coordination fee waived.
RMA Ops: Logged action: RMA-8742 created, depot window booked 03/26 07:00-11:00 CET.
Sam Cheng: Closing thread — will reopen if customs hiccup.
Jeff Patel: Thanks.
